en.headline: Greater Bay Airlines opens first Indonesia route to Surabaya
en.dek: The carrier flew its inaugural Hong Kong–Surabaya service on Friday and plans up to four flights a week on the new link.
body: Greater Bay Airlines has launched its first scheduled service to Indonesia, operating an inaugural flight from Hong Kong International Airport to Surabaya’s Juanda International Airport on Friday afternoon.

The Indonesian Consulate-General in Hong Kong said flight HB211, a Boeing 737-800, carried about 170 passengers of a maximum 189 on the opening sector. Acting Consul-General Baskara Pradipta attended the send-off with the airline’s chief executive, Hou Wei, Civil Aviation Department Director-General Clara Wong and Airport Authority officials.

The airline said the route is planned to operate up to four times a week. Cathay Pacific already flies the city pair daily. The new service is intended to add capacity for tourism and business travel between Hong Kong and East Java.
Friday’s departure coincided with the Mid-Autumn Festival. The Civil Aviation Department and the Airport Authority did not separately issue a detailed traffic forecast for the new frequency.

zh.headline: 大灣區航空開通首條印尼航線 直飛泗水
zh.dek: 大灣區航空周五開辦香港至泗水定期航班，計劃每周最多四班，屬該公司首條印尼航線。
body: 大灣區航空已開通首條往來印尼的定期航線，周五下午由香港國際機場起飛，前往泗水朱安達國際機場。
印尼駐港總領事館表示，首航班機編號HB211，由波音737-800執飛，載客約170人，機位上限189個。署理總領事巴斯卡拉與航空公司行政總裁侯偉、民航處處長黃嘉麗及機管局代表出席啟航儀式。
航空公司計劃該航線每周最多四班。國泰已每日飛行同一航線。新航班旨在增加香港與東爪哈之間的旅遊及商務運力。
首航當日適逢中秋節。民航處及機管局未有就新增班次另行公布詳細客量預測。
